status: frozen 2026-10-02 before any described or renamed query was sent
decision: user 2026-10-02: answer the PTA reviewers' knowledge/recognition concern with knowledge conditions on the v3 fixtures that hold no untargeted Skill
question: Is the v3 H-use result limited by missing game knowledge (base prompts show card names only) or carried by name familiarity?

fixture_subset.rule: drop a fixture if its hand, draw or discard pile holds a targeted Skill; the controlled-H interface plays every Skill untargeted, so the frozen oracle scores these as enemy no-ops (decision_log 2026-10-02). The rule reads card names only, never model output.

model_rationale: llama-3.1-8b: non-thinking, tight base null; gpt-oss-120b: the only model whose choices track H. Both have complete, gate-valid base runs.

described.prompt_change: the frozen prompt with effects_appendix(state) inserted immediately before the final 'Choose the next action' instruction; system prompt unchanged

renamed.prompt_change: described, then: the system prompt's game sentence rewritten; every proper name (cards incl. engine ids, enemies, relics, distinctive move names, Slay the Spire / Ironclad / Silent) replaced by its neutral token in system and user prompts; private engine-flag keys replaced per flag_key_map; generic mechanic keywords (Strength, Block, Poison, Vulnerable, ...) kept and defined in the reference

system_prompt_rewrite.from: You are an expert Slay the Spire player controlling the {character}.
system_prompt_rewrite.to: You are an expert player of a deterministic deck-building card game.

renamed.leak_check: the runner refuses a prompt in which any original proper name survives as a whole word

unchanged: oracles, scorer, response contract, request payload (max_tokens 16000, temperature, seed), serving stacks and model revisions, 8-way concurrency, smoke gate, truncation and excluded-pair gates

analysis.primary: per model x character on the subset, paired by fixture at H8: knowledge = DiD of (g_described - g_base); familiarity = DiD of (g_renamed - g_described); g = EQ8(a8) - EQ8(a1) under the frozen oracle; sensitive-minus-control bootstrap as in v3
analysis.bootstrap: v3 replicates (10,000); seeds = v3 per-character seed + 300 (knowledge) / + 400 (familiarity)
analysis.validity: a contrast can reject only if both conditions it compares pass the v3 gates; base validity is the model's frozen v3 analysis
secondary_descriptive: H8 lookahead-use rate on sensitive fixtures per condition, McNemar exact between conditions
mean H8 effective quality per condition
truncation and illegal rates per condition
analysis.base_comparator: the model's frozen v3 base rows restricted to the same 1,169 fixtures (H1 and H8 only)

deferred: knowledge probe (non-interactive questions scored against the same effect table) goes in a separate amendment
disclosures: The subset over-represents Ironclad (655 vs 514 Silent fixtures) and excludes Silent poison/debuff decks; claims are scoped to fixtures without targeted Skills.

The effect reference describes OUR engine, which deviates from the real game in recorded places (effect_text real_game notes); for those cards described prompts contradict pretrained knowledge by design.
Base rows were collected under a 4-horizon schedule (H1/H2/H4/H8, Latin-square order); condition rows use H1/H8 only, so query order and context differ beyond the prompt change.
Condition prompts are longer by about 640-1,270 tokens; truncation is gated as in v3.
Post hoc in origin: the exclusion rule and these conditions were designed after seeing base results, but before any condition query.
